Description

The standard magitek armor built with an integrated CPU to think for itself and learn. Also used to protect and serve.

Defense

AC 20, touch 10, flat-footed 19 (+1 dex, +10 natural, -1 size)

hp 85 [130] (10d10+30), Force Field (50 hp, fast healing 10)

Fort +8, Ref +7, Will +7

Hardness 5, resilient; Immune Construct traits

Resist Ice 10, Fire 10

Weakness Critical hits and Lightning

Offense

Speed 30 ft.

Melee 2 Claws +15 (1d8+6)

Ranged Integrated Laser Rifle +10 touch (2d8 fire)

Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.

Special Attacks Combined Arms, Mini Rockets, Tek Laser

Statistics

Str 22, Dex 12, Con -, Int 12, Wis 12, Cha 1

Base Atk +10; CMB +19; CMD 28 (can't be tripped)

Feats Alertness, Combat Reflexes, Deadly Aim, Great Fortitude, Precise Shot

Skills Climb +6, Perception +16, Sense Motive +12

Languages Common + one more

save.description: Staggered for one round instead of stunned

effect: After extra damage from a critical, stunned one round on failure. Specific machina exception to ordinary construct immunity. Applies with the field down only.

description.value: As part of a full-attack action, a magitek armor can attack with both melee and ranged integrated weapons.

effect: Use both +15 claws and one +10 integrated laser shot. Respect the rifle's single use per round.

description.value: A magitek armor is sheathed in a thin layer of shimmering energy that grants it 50 bonus hit points. All damage dealt to a magitek armor with an active force field is reduced from these hit points first. As long as the force field is active, the magitek armor is immune to critical hits. A magitek armor's force field has fast healing 10, but once its hit points are reduced to 0, the force field shuts down and does not reactivate for 24 hours.

effect: Read remaining field HP on the item. If above zero, add 10 up to 50 each round; damage reduces field HP first. At zero, no healing for 24h. Never apply this as hull healing.

description.value: As a standard action, a magitek armor can fire a rocket to a range of 400 feet. A rocket explodes on impact in a 30- foot-radius burst, dealing 3d6 points of fire damage and 3d6 points of bludgeoning damage to all creatures in the area (Reflex DC 16 halves). A magitek armor carries a maximum of five mini rockets. Its core can replenish fired rockets at the rate of one per 6 hours, crafting new rockets from scrap metal and other collected components used in the construction process. The save DC is Intelligence-based.

save.description: Half both components. Recover one spent rocket per six hours with scrap, maximum five.

effect: Half both components. Recover one spent rocket per six hours with scrap, maximum five.

description.value: Magitek armor receive a +3 racial bonus on all saving throws.
Magitek see invisible creatures and objects as if they were visible.

Once every 1d4 rounds and as a standard action, a magitek armor can fire a blue blast from its chest in a 30-ft.-cone. All creatures caught within the area of effect take 5d8 points of non-elemental damage, a Reflex save (DC 16) for half damage. Those failing the Reflex save must make a Fortitude save (DC 16) or be stunned for 1d3 rounds. Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Engineering or Technology DC 23).

save.description: Half. On failure also roll Fortitude DC 16 or stunned for [[1d3]] rounds.

effect: Half. On failure also roll Fortitude DC 16 or stunned for [[1d3]] rounds.

specialAbility.blueMage: Blue mages may learn this ability as a 4th level spell (Knowledge: Engineering or Technology DC 23).

effect: Once per round, no AoO in melee. Passes through force effects; invisible targets immune.
